_readme: Planned items that are NOT in the game yet, with the prices worked out on 2026-09-20 (see docs/FUTURE_PRICES.md for the reasoning). The game does not read this file. To add one, copy its entries into economy.json (a projectile needs a `shop.items` entry AND a `projectiles.<id>` entry, a buff only a `shop.items` entry), add its picture, and check 'py tools/economy_report.py'. Names, images and descriptions are placeholders. Basis: 75% hit rate, one use of a buff = one stack of its own tier, buff price = 60% of the return, +-25% ranges, hit value = 1.6 x the average price per piece. (The common 1.1x coin bonus was added to the game as Snowy Cube on 2026-09-20, so it is no longer listed here.) The rare 20% save was added as Mints on 2026-09-20. The legendary Sure Shot (a guaranteed hit) was built as the Diamond Cross on 2026-09-20. The legendary 1.5x coin bonus was added as Daniel's 3 PLN on 2026-09-20. The epic standard projectile was added as the Tomato on 2026-09-20. The epic 50% save was added as the epic Mints (id mints_epic) on 2026-09-20.

projectiles._note: LEGENDARY STANDARD. Average stack 15000, hit value 4800 (the legendary rarity default).
LEGENDARY HEAVY HITTER: a stack of 1-3, price per piece 2.5x the standard, hit value 2.5x (12000). Average stack 15000.

buffs._note: LEGENDARY FREE THROW (replaces the legendary 50% save): a one-time charge, no timer - the NEXT throw that would use up a bought projectile does not (never spent on the snowball; the save-chance roll comes first and the charge is only spent if that fails; several charges queue one per throw). NEEDS A NEW MECHANIC (effect 'freeThrow'). Worth one piece of the best projectile (3,000 standard, 7,500 heavy hitter): priced at one standard piece.
buffs.name: TBD

buffs._note: LEGENDARY DISCO SUMMON (planned, needs wiring): using it starts the disco event (main.js startDiscoEvent) between throws; refused while any event runs (Buffs.eventBlocked already does that for every buff with a triggerEvent effect). Unlike Tomato Juice it must not end with a timer - the event has its own length (song 164 s + applause 21 s) - so it needs the same 'charge' treatment as the Diamond Cross (charge: true, used up when the event starts) and syncBuffEvent must start an event BY NAME from the effect value. Price estimate: see docs/FUTURE_PRICES.md 'Disco buff'.
buffs.name: TBD

price_ladder_summary.face_multiplier: x2.5 fits a legendary standard projectile; with a lower-tier projectile it pays little (a buff for the best projectile). If it should depend on the projectile: 2.5 x the buff's price / the hit value, kept between x2 and x20.
price_ladder_summary.save_chance_ladder: 10% common (Water Bottle), 20% rare (Mints), 50% epic (planned); they stack as independent rolls, 64% together, capped at 90%. Legendary = a one-time free throw instead of a percentage.
price_ladder_summary.stacking: Save chances: independent rolls, cap 90%. Coin multipliers and offset slow-downs multiply, no cap.
